senses.gloss: f. (an adaptation of annona, cmp. אַנּוֹנָא a. טַסְקָא) [chest, treasury, v. preced.] tax from crops and other farmer’s produces delivered in kind. Y. Keth. XIII, 35ᵈ א׳ גולגולת annona and poll-tax.—
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 6a:2">Pes. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>בהמת א׳</he> cattle subject to the annona (v. D. C. ed. Hensch, s. v. Annona: ‘capitur etiam in pecudibus’); <he>עיסת א׳</he> dough made of flour subject to annona.—Pl. <he>אַרְנוֹנוֹת</he>, <he>אַרְנוֹנִיּוֹת</he>, <he>אַרְנוֹנִין</he>.
